proof_roadmap: 对每个 x ∈ U 取 i_x 使 x ∈ U_{i_x}，再由基的性质取 B_{i_x} ∈ B 满足 x ∈ B_{i_x} ⊂ U_{i_x}。
以 J = {i_x} 为指标，令 V_j = B_{i_x}，即得由基元素组成、细化原覆盖的开覆盖。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that any open covering of a subset can be refined by an open covering whose members belong to a given basis for the topology (author lemma at source lines 551-559, label lemma-refine-covering-basis). The proof (source lines 561-567) chooses for each point a basis member between the point and a member of the covering and reindexes these basis members by the points (proof lines 561-566). The pointwise choice and reindexing are the content. H2.
